handoff: review#7: review#4-6 F1 fixed (--until merged), unit tier + typecheck green, D1-D5 sound, every B item traced. Blocking: F1 (B41) Load rule's 'rerun the step once' is refused (unit back at implement is running; run cancel forbidden except for flakes) — reuse the flake cancel→rerun --step path and widen the cancel exception (SKILL.md, B16, SK3); F2 (B15) gh run rerun --failed alone still sends the story to implement (ci check fails on the cancelled run) — same cancel→rerun --step ci path. Minor: Allowed list omits named merge/watch restart, delegated reject + mailbox untested, story-edit usage vs refuse, overloaded 'delegated'. Table in handoff.

findings.title: Load rule's 'rerun the step once' is refused, and the way out is forbidden
findings.detail:
B41: 'a check fails with `reason: timeout` while the load is far above the core count → the subagent waits for the load to drop and reruns the step once'. A failed check goes to implement (quick.yaml:55 `fail: { to: implement }`), so the unit is running implement. `norn run rerun` refuses a running unit (`running`, packages/cli/src/commands/run-rerun.ts:40), and its do-instead `run cancel` is forbidden at SKILL.md:47 ('`norn run cancel` for anything but a suspected-flake rerun'). The B16 example in the spec (line 81) and SK3 carry the same limit.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Give the Load rule the same cancel → wait stuck → `run rerun --step <check> --delegated --reason` sequence as the flake rule, guarded by 'no commit newer than the check receipt', and widen the `run cancel` exception (SKILL.md Allowed/Forbidden, spec B16, SK3) to 'right before a delegated rerun at a check (flake or load)'. Pin it with an assets term.

findings.title: CI-glitch rerun still sends the story to implement
findings.detail:
B15: 'I want a hung or cancelled CI run rerun, so that a CI glitch does not send the story back to implement.' The skill says '`gh run rerun --failed <id>` once, then wait on the `ci` check as usual'. The `ci` check watches the run (`gh run watch --exit-status`), so a cancelled run fails it and routes it to implement (quick.yaml:97 `fail: { to: implement, counter: ci_loop }`). The rerun on GitHub does not bring the unit back to `ci`. As written, the benefit B15 asks for is not delivered.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: After `gh run rerun --failed`, if the unit has gone to implement with no newer commit, use the same cancel → `run rerun <unit> --step ci --delegated --reason` sequence as F1. Name it in the skill and assert the term.

findings.title: Allowed list omits the merge and watch restart that B24/B40 allow when named
findings.detail:
SKILL.md:54 allows a merge with a squash, and :60 allows a watch restart, when the request names them. The Allowed list permits only 'reading with `gh`', and Forbidden lists `norn watch` with no exception.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add 'when the request named it: `gh pr merge --squash`, install/pull/restart of watch' to the Allowed list as exceptions.

findings.title: Delegated reject and mailbox delivery of a delegated receipt are untested
findings.detail:
The describe block is titled '…and a delegated reject (B42, B21)' but runs no reject. D2 says 'a mailbox delivery (T9) carries it unchanged', and no test covers it. A delegated answer's run view mark is not asserted.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add a delegated reject at a gate (run list/story view mark), and one delegated answer via the mailbox path.

findings.title: State-based refusal reported as a usage error (P8)
findings.detail:
`--delegated`/`--reason` on a story that has not started, or on a slice, depends on the unit's state, so a rule is saying no. It throws usageError (exit 2) instead of refuse (exit 3 with a code).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: refuse(...) with a code. Keep usage only for the flag-shape check.

findings.title: `delegated` means five different things
findings.detail:
StoryView.delegated is a DelegatedDecision[], StepRow.delegated is true, RoundView.delegated is a reason string, the receipt's delegated is true, and status --json delegated is a count map. RoundView.delegated holding a reason is especially misleading.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Rename RoundView.delegated to delegated_reason (and status's field to delegated_counts).

findings.title: Answer line duplicated in timeline.ts:40 and steps.ts:201
findings.detail:
Both build `answer${delegatedMark(r)}: ${r.answer}${r.comment ? ...}` identically.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: One helper next to decisionSuffix.

findings.title: delegatedDecisions re-reads every round per loadProjectView (accepted)
findings.detail:
status --segment runs every few seconds, and the cost grows with stories × rounds. This was accepted in review#3 with a comment. A cache keyed on round-folder mtime would avoid review#2 F3's staleness.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional, later.

findings.title: Delegated markdown line built in cli, not view's format.ts
findings.detail:
Every other status line is rendered in @norn/view format.ts.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move it to format.ts.
